{{< include ../../assets/html/edgewise-embed.html >}}

Networks sampled from a model, where the right answer is known.

Every figure here is live: drag a node, hover for a name, and *Open with controls* gives you the same view in a full window with the colouring and layout options exposed. The data, and the script that rebuilds each one from its source, are in the [`networks`](https://github.com/maxjerdee/networks) repository.

## Synthetic SBM: assortative (q=30) {#sym-q-30-c-5-lambda-3-t-9}

```{=html}
<div class="ew-embed" data-network="sym_q_30_c_5_lambda_3_t_9.gml"
     data-params="colorAttr=group&sizeAttr=degree&edgeOpacity=0.15"
     data-caption="Synthetic SBM: assortative (q=30) — 1000 nodes, 2215 edges, undirected"></div>
```

| | |
|---|---|
| **A node** | Node, colored by its planted group |
| **An edge** | Edge sampled from an assortative planted-partition SBM: mostly within a group |

Synthetic sym stochastic block model: n = 1000, q = 30 planted groups, target mean degree c = 5, assortative: most edges fall inside a node's own planted group (lambda = 3). Generated in Mathematica for the ASBM resolution-limit tests; trial file sym_q_30_c_5_lambda_3_t_9.gml.

*[data and build script](https://github.com/maxjerdee/networks/tree/main/networks/sym_q_30_c_5_lambda_3_t_9)*

**Licence.** Generated for this repository's own ASBM tests; no third-party data rights apply. Covered by this repository's own licence.

## Synthetic SBM: ring (q=30) {#ring-q-30-c-5-lambda-0-t-1}

```{=html}
<div class="ew-embed" data-network="ring_q_30_c_5_lambda_0_t_1.gml"
     data-params="colorAttr=group&sizeAttr=degree&edgeOpacity=0.15"
     data-caption="Synthetic SBM: ring (q=30) — 1000 nodes, 2412 edges, undirected"></div>
```

| | |
|---|---|
| **A node** | Node, colored by its planted group |
| **An edge** | Edge sampled from a ring SBM: group r links almost only to groups r±1 |

Synthetic ring stochastic block model: n = 1000, q = 30 planted groups, target mean degree c = 5, disassortative ring: group r connects almost only to groups r-1 and r+1 (lambda = 0). Generated in Mathematica for the ASBM resolution-limit tests; trial file ring_q_30_c_5_lambda_0_t_1.gml.

*[data and build script](https://github.com/maxjerdee/networks/tree/main/networks/ring_q_30_c_5_lambda_0_t_1)*

**Licence.** Generated for this repository's own ASBM tests; no third-party data rights apply. Covered by this repository's own licence.
